tenures.finisher: No Moment (Submission) — The victim lies on their back on the mat, with Dread standing over top of them.  Dread picks up the victim’s legs as if he were getting ready for a wishbone legsplit, but he suddenly spins around so his back is facing the opponent, while holding onto the victim’s ankles.  Dread then steps over so the victim is back on their stomach, and he has the victim’s feet/legs locked under his armpits, with their lower body going under his legs, but their upper body and head are still on the mat (essentially a Boston crab of Walls of Jericho, except Dread faces the opposite direction).  He then reaches down to the opponent, still lying on their stomach, then grabs their arms and picks them up into the air, suspending them. 5- Double Springboard Hurricanrana (runs at turnbuckle, climbs up and springs off both sets of rope on both sides of the turnbuckle, then flies at the victim and delivers a hurricanrana.)
7- Rolling Senton (Opponent lies on the mat, Dread runs at the victim, does a forward roll, and as he gets back up from the first roll, does a flip splash onto the victim.  Think Rob Van Dam.)
10- Reverse neckbreaker on opponent sitting on top turnbuckle

tenures.bio:
Sylkk was born and raised in Soux Falls, North Dakota. When he first appeared on the CCW scene back in September of 1998, he decided to make the biggest impact as possible upon entering. He started his career as a face and was to square off against Iron Barbarian, in his very first match. It was a hard fought match, however Sylkk did manage to pull through. This was a confrontation that was far from over, as Iron Barbarian, and the remaining members of Dark Syde, relentlessly went after him. He found security and closure in meeting up with JC Superstar and GOD, whom happened to end up being one of the best tag teams in CCW history. The three of them had quite a few battles against Dark Syde, before finally forcing them out of CCW for good.

A short time after this, Sylkk had decided he was being over-shadowed by this tag team duo, and decided it was time to split. He challenged the two of the to several matches, but the commissioner would not approve of it. Eventually, Sylkk and JC would meet up in one on one competition, where JC got the better end of the stick. Not to long following this match, JC and GOD much like that of Dark Syde disappeared from CCW.

Sylkk went on about a singles career that was going no where. He was making all enemies and no friends. He was pissing off everyone from Tim Inman to Phil Burner. Then one day out of the blue, he demanded a shot at, then CCW great, Supreme Machine. This match was signed and Sylkk was destroyed. He was very unhappy with the referee's in CCW, and decided to take a leave. While on leave however, his younger brother, The Camargo Kid, decided to try his luck in CCW. Upon hearing this, of course Sylkk was going to return.

In 1999, Sylkk (Independent Champion) teamed up with Bobby Blades (Heavyweight Champ), Sid Powers (Trans-Atlantic Champ), Corey James (Hardcore Champ),Ace Hawk, Debbie Carmichal, Candy Bytch (Women's Champ), Lin Xio, and The Camargo Kid. Within this group they held every title except for the ever popular lightweight title and the Tag Team titles. This group was known as The Franchise. However after certain arguments arose over copyright infringments, one member, Sid Powers, took the rights to The Franchise, and signed them over to Sylkk, seeing as he was the final remaining member, of an earlier 'Franchise'. This group of fun loving kids, soon turned against the world, as they would do anything to keep their titles.

Soon they found Ace to be a liability and released him from the group with a formal beating on the following show. WAI immediately accquired this soon to be superstar, and this sparked a whole new fued between WAI and The Franchise. In the following months Sid Powers left the group and joined WAI, in what turned out to be a angle to get at them from the inside. However, before it was all said and done, Sylkk took it upon himself to end the career of Sid Powers. With the Franchise beginning to fall apart, several other members faded away, and eventually it only left, Sylkk, Bobby Blades, The Camargo Kid, Lin Xio, and the newly acquired Jaicee Davis.

After another month or so, Lin Xio had been kidnapped by terrorists which led to her death, and this really weighed on Sylkk's mind. He eventually snapped. He threw acid into the face of his brother, which was to intentionally end his career, and this left just the three of them to remain.

That year as Gold & Glory came to pass, Sylkk turned on Blades, and launched him backwards off of a 75'platform, basically ending his career. Blades has attempted to return twice, but his back has not allowed it. Sylkk has been referred to since, by several people, as 'The Career Killer'. The times passed and Sylkk ran rampant. Trying harder everyday to end more careers, until one day, he recieved his waivers from the CCW.

Sylkk spent 2000 mostly in rehab, trying to straighten out his mental state, before finally being released. Upon his release he went back to the CCW to seek work again. Upon his return he found that, CCW was under new management, and he decided to test the waters. During this stint, he managed to capture the Hardcore title. Before once again, being released.

2001 rolled around and CCW had yet again come under new management. Sylkk again, appealed to the board of directors who allowed him to return yet again. This time upon his return, he and Brad Lamen captured the tag team titles. This makes, Hardcore, Indy, & Tag Team Titles that he has held. He eventually was disgusted with CCW enterprises, and thought about turning in his resignation. However, as he watched CCW deteriorate, he decided to proclaim a mutiny and take over CCW Ent. He ran the CCW smoothly, keeping budget good, and the locker room happy. Aside from one person that is. 6 months later, Sylkk was shot 6 times, by an accused, Eric Clark. There were no witnesses however, he was the main suspect. Sylkk was rushed to the hospital where he underwent massive treatment. Reports kept CCW updated on his condition, as Spider, stepped in to office to take over. Suddenly one day, he vanished from the hospital with no reports from the doctors. Many had thought him dead. Many had thought him paralyzed. What they did not expect was for him to return.

Sylkk did return, once he made his return he was teamed with the man who tried to kill him in Eric Clark, at Group Therapy where the two of them could not co-exist and cost their team the win.  About a month had passed when at the following Pay Per View, Sylkk uncovered the plot of his attempted assassination.  Spider had arranged it all and was the man behind the attempt.  Sylkk had him arrested and immediately reclaimed his throne as CCW President.

Upon hearing of this comeback, another CCW legend posed a comeback.  Sylkk's one time friend and partner, Bobby Blades.  Bobby Blades, was on his way back to CCW to end a feud that had been about 2 years in the workings.  One month had passed, and Bobby Blades was set to face Sylkk at the Pay per View.  Career vs Career  This was for all the marbles and the loser would be forever banished from CCW competition, or staff positions.  The match never aired.  Sylkk never showed up at the arena.  The Pay Per View was cancelled.  This was leaving all of CCW in disarray, and it brinked with disaster.  One Month later, Brady Jacobson appeared as a favor to Sylkk, and CCW was rebuilt and refashioned to his liking.  Sylkk was never heard from again......until now.  With this storied past, and his leader by fear attitude, what will he have in store for RUSH, and all of the wrestlers here?  Only time will tell.

tenures.bio:
A child was born on July 16th, 1976 to the loving parents in Joann and Herbert Marshall, named Joshua Scott Marshall. His childhood was nothing of an ordinary one, as his mother saw potential in him for being a runway model, or something along those lines. Her constant pushing didn’t really bother Joshua so much in the beginning, seeing as how he loved doing things alongside him mother, but that would all change after several years of being told what to do all the time. Joshua went on to gain success in many ways as a youngster, starring in many clothing commercials and winning numerous child model contest and being told by several modeling agencies that if he kept up his work that he would be awarded a contract as soon as he had graduated from High School. Joshua makes his way through school and graduates from High School at the top of his class; an honor student and captain of the school football team, but his dreams weren’t set on being the runway model that his mother had so dearly deserved of him. He left home without his parents consent and joined up with a largely popular Cyberspace Championship Wrestling, working there for several months and acquiring training from the veteran in Jesse Ramey and soon after beginning to date his daughter Michelle, Josh achieved glory after winning the CCW Lightweight Title and soon after going mysterious for several months, in which he took up a modeling career until he was contacted by Jesse about a job opening in a rival promotion of his called RUSH Wrestling. Josh made his way to the headquarters of RUSH and had a very intriguing interview with the bosses to say the least and was shortly after hired under a long contract.
